definition: means a section of the Act;
means the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority;
means a direction issued by the Authority under section 14;
means a condition imposed by the Authority under section 7;
includes all current and former licenceholders;
has the meaning given by the Regulated Activities Order 2011;
means a serious contravention of the Act or any prohibition or requirement imposed under the Act;
means the class or classes of regulated activity to which the serious regulatory failing is attributable, but does not mean individual subclasses;
means Financial Services Rule Book 2016 and "rule" without more means a rule contained in the Rule Book;
means the period by the end of which a return is required to be submitted or otherwise provided to the Authority.
